explainer.title: What the plan counts
explainer.body: A plan run compares every confirmed order of the site with the stock it may use and the goods already ordered, and lists what is missing. It never orders anything by itself.
explainer.need: Need: what the orders still need, per material and colour, from the released bill of materials (wastage included), less what was already issued to their work orders.
explainer.usable: Usable stock: released lots (with a chromium VI pass when the material needs the test) in the same colour.
explainer.held: Not counted: lots in quarantine, blocked or rejected, and other colours — each listed with its reason.
explainer.onOrder: On order: open purchase lines that arrive by the need date (the confirmed date when the supplier gave one).
explainer.buy: Buy: the shortage in the supplier’s unit, rounded up to whole units, the minimum and the multiple; leather also in about how many hides.
explainer.orderBy: Order by: the need date less the supplier’s lead time.
explainer.never: Draft PO puts a line into the supplier’s draft purchase order; nothing is sent until a buyer sends it.
